Name: Mizu's Peafowl
Author: MizuJakkaru
Description:
[center]﻿﻿[img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img][/center]
Do you wish to add some regal peafowl to your farm? This mod is for you if you like all things about peacocks! It adds peafowl as a new [b]coop [/b]animal.

[list]
[*]Peafowl (of either sex) lay [b]Peafowl Eggs[/b] every five days.[/*]
[*]Peafowl (of either sex) drop [b]Peacock Feathers[/b] at high friendship.[/*]
[*]Peafowl are a tropical treasure! [b]Marnie [/b]will add them to her stock after you unlock [b]Ginger Island[/b] and complete the [b]Special Order: Plumes of Pride.[/b][/*]
[/list][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] required to play this mod.[/b] It allows the animal to squeeze through the small door of the coops.

This mod has optional [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] compatibility, with 1 new recipe to find and cook up.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/OGZGOGL.png[/img][/b][/center]
By default the Blue and Brown appearances are enabled. You can toggle on more below.

[b]Enable Brown Peahen [/b](true by default): Enables the Brown Peahen texture and adds it to the possible peafowl appearances.
[b]Enable Gray Peahen [/b](false by default)[b]:[/b] Enables the Gray Peahen texture and adds it to the possible peafowl appearances.
[b]Enable Green [/b][b]Peacock [/b](false by default): Enables the Green Peacock texture and adds it to the possible peafowl appearances.
[b]Enable Black Peacock[/b] (false by default): Enables the Black Peacock texture and adds it to the possible peafowl appearances..
[b]Enable White Peacock[/b] (false by default): Enables the White Peacock texture and adds it to the possible peafowl appearances.
[center]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img][/b][/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url]
4. (Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url] for some bonus features
5. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
6. (Optional) Download the Animal Husbandry .zip file from this mod and install it the same way you installed the other mods
7. When starting up the game for the first time, use Generic Mod Config Menu to choose which options you want to turn on or off.
You're ready to play!

To remove this mod, you can just delete it from your mod folder. Any animals and items still left in your save file will [b]safely[/b] be left behind as error items, which can be thrown away or sold by right clicking on animals.

Deleted it by accident? No problem! Just reinstall the mod, and your error items will become normal items again. It's that easy!
